lines.beaver: 새로 온 도윤 씨, 좀 건방지지 않아요?
lines.beaver_en: Isn't the new guy, Doyun, a bit arrogant?
lines.beaver_roman: saero on doyun ssi, jom geonbangjiji anayo?
lines.en: I think he's confident rather than arrogant.

lines.beaver: 회의 때 막무가내로 자기 말만 하던데요.
lines.beaver_en: In meetings he stubbornly talks only about his own ideas.
lines.beaver_roman: hoeui ttae mangmugaero jagi malman hadeondeyo.
lines.en: He's not unreasonable; he's just full of passion.

lines.learner: 독선적이진 않아요. 남의 의견도 잘 들어요.
lines.en: He's not self-righteous. He listens to others well.
lines.roman: dokseonjeogijin anayo. name uigyeondo jal deureoyo.

lines.beaver_en: But he seems a bit closed off.
lines.en: It's just that he's still new. He's actually very open.
He's witty and smart. Cultured, too.

lines.beaver_en: He picked at my report yesterday, though. What about that?
lines.learner: 좋은 뜻으로 한 말일 거예요. 악의는 없어요.
lines.en: He probably meant well. There's no ill will.
lines.roman: joeun tteuseuro han maril geoyeyo. agineun eopseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: They say he's exclusive and only looks after his own people.
lines.en: You shouldn't judge him just from rumors.

lines.beaver_en: Was I too harsh on him?
lines.learner: 네, 좀 가혹했어요. 배타적인 사람도 아니에요.
lines.en: Yes, a bit cruel. He's not exclusive, either.
lines.roman: ne, jom gahokaesseoyo. baetajeogin saramdo anieyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then why is he usually so quiet?
lines.learner: 수줍음이 많아서 그래요. 먼저 말 걸어 보세요.
lines.en: He's just very shy. Try talking to him first.
lines.roman: sujubeumi manaseo geuraeyo. meonjeo mal georeo boseyo.

lines.beaver: 알겠어요. 오늘 점심에 같이 가자고 할게요.
lines.beaver_en: Okay. I'll ask him to lunch today.
lines.beaver_roman: algesseoyo. oneul jeomsime gachi gajago halgeyo.
lines.learner: 좋아요. 서로 마음을 열면 금방 친해질 거예요.
lines.en: Great. If you open up to each other, you'll be close soon.
lines.roman: joayo. seoro maeumeul yeolmyeon geumbang chinhaejil geoyeyo.
